dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: You made it back in one piece! I did warn you they wouldn't be happy about it.

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: Electricity's fixed, pipe's fixed, and those freeloaders are disconnected. You've done more for this house in one day than the previous owners managed all year.

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: Here, take this. It's not much, but it should cover the TV license at least. Wouldn't want the inspectors knocking on your door next.
